description: This file defines API routes for managing posts and engagements in a social media application, using FastAPI's APIRouter. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, and deleting posts, as well as creating and listing engagements such as likes or comments. It leverages dependency injection to get the current user and interacts with the database through imported query functions.

methods.name: create_post(payload: PostCreate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new post in the database for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_my_posts(user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves all posts authored by the current user.

methods.name: delete_post(post_id: int, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a post if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: create_engagement(post_id: int, payload: EngagementCreate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates an engagement (like, comment, share) for a specific post.

methods.name: list_engagements(post_id: int, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all engagements for a specific post.
